comment: In-game verification of user-placed neutral camp-creep markers. Places two CampCreepMarker nodes at distinct world positions via the dev_command hook, forces MinigameCampCreeps to spawn a fully-managed camp at each (index 100+), then probes camp state to confirm the user camps exist with 10 idle creeps, correct HP/scale/invuln, and that on_wave_started mixes in new types. Also captures before/after screenshots of a marker + camp.
